info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Webhook Endpoint Management API
info.description: The Webhook Endpoint Management API enables users to modify existing webhook endpoints. This API allows businesses to update configurations and settings associated with webhook integrations, ensuring real-time data synchronization with external systems. Typical consumers include developers and system integrators who are implementing webhook functionalities to facilitate event-driven architectures. With this endpoint, users can adapt their webhook settings as their business requirements evolve, streamlining integration processes.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to modify the settings or details of a specific webhook identified by its unique resource ID. Ensure that you provide the necessary parameters for a successful update.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the webhook endpoint with the specified ID. It includes information that defines the new configuration settings for the webhook, such as its URL and event types. Ensure that the necessary fields are included and correctly formatted to successfully process the update.

200.description: Request completed successfully, and the resource has been updated.
